name: Kartu Kredit BNI Garuda Indonesia Visa Platinum
welcomeBonus: 200 GarudaMiles on approval. The larger welcome bonus this card once paid was withdrawn during 2025.
notes: From 26 February 2026 the rate is Rp 100.000 for 2 GarudaMiles, one mile per Rp 50.000 — a quarter of what the Signature earns. What the Platinum paid before that date was not published, so the entry runs the current rate from the start and an earlier cycle is underestimated.
Every figure is from PinterPoin and Cermati. BNI's and Garuda Indonesia's own pages could not be reached, so nothing is confirmed against the issuer.

The card earns GarudaMiles directly rather than a bank currency, so there is nothing to transfer: the miles are already Garuda's. Miles collected on the card move to the GarudaMiles account once 2.500 have built up.
The published rate is written as two miles per a larger amount; it is recorded here as one mile per half that, which is the same thing on whole multiples and clearer to read.

No source lists the transactions that earn nothing. Most Indonesian cards exclude cash advance, balance transfers, instalments and fees, but none of that is encoded here because none of it was published, so such spend is overestimated.
Rounding is taken as per full increment, in line with the other entries; the sources do not say how a part increment is treated.
A cardholder spending at least Rp 8.000.000 a month for the first five months after activation is fast-tracked to GarudaMiles Gold. That is a status benefit, not points, and is not modelled.
During 2025 the welcome bonus, the loyalty bonus and partner domestic lounge access were all withdrawn.
